note: Scam ads are reconstructed from patterns in public news reports and regulator warnings; phone numbers use the UK's fictional drama range (+44 7700 900xxx) and fictional Indian test numbers. Genuine ads use published Jul-Sep 2026 small-savings rates.

ads.title: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (post office)
ads.based_on: Govt of India small-savings rates Jul–Sep 2026: SCSS 8.2% (Business Today, 30 Jun 2026)
ads.text: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) — a Government of India savings scheme for citizens aged 60 and above. Interest 8.2% per annum for the July–September 2026 quarter, paid every quarter. Deposit from ₹1,000 up to ₹30 lakh. Tax deduction available under Section 80C. Open your account at any post office or authorised bank branch. Details: www.indiapost.gov.in
